blocks.html: Robinsons Malls, the commercial centers unit under Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) and one of the biggest mall chains in the country, recently garnered three notable awards from the prestigious Philippine Quill Awards 2015. The “Maskara at the Mall” won the Award of Merit for Special Events for Robinsons Place Bacolod’s under the Communication Skills category. Robinsons Place Bacolod, one of the forty-two malls of RLC, stands as the first full-service shopping mall in Bacolod City, Negros Occidental. It is a 3-level shopping development with over 120 local and international retail outlets, restaurants, recreation & entertainment facilities, and service centers. Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center won the Award of Excellence under the Non-Profit Campaign category. Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center (RMLPC) is a public service program of Robinsons Malls. At present, there are 28 RMLPCs nationwide housing 19 government agencies such as Bureau of Immigration, Department of Foreign Affairs, Department of Trade & Industry, Department of Tourism, Professional Regulations Commission, Land Registration Authority, Land Transportation Office, National Bureau of Investigation, Philippine Health Insurance, Philippine Postal Corporation, Home Development Mutual Fund (Pag-Ibig), Government Service Insurance System, Securities and Exchange Commission, Social Security System, Technical Education and Skills Development Authority, Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Authority, Philippine Overseas Employment Administration, Overseas Workers Welfare Administration and now Commission on Elections (COMELEC). Robinsons Malls App won the Award of Excellence under the Digital Communications category. The Robinsons Malls app brings the modern mall and extends the convenience of shopping and entertainment through the use of smartphones. The app features store directory functions, Lingkod Pinoy listings, access to public transportation, and directions going to the nearest Robinsons Malls. It also extends the ease of your Robinsons Malls experiences with movie ticket purchase and seat selection, making your mall visit and movie watching a breeze.
